label: Answer Agent
description: Put a coding agent's `question` (from AskAgent) to a person as a form, and hand their `answer` back for AskAgent's next firing. The form is built from the question itself: each of the agent's questions with its options to pick (one, or several when the agent allows it) and a box for another answer when the agent takes one; for a permission request, what the agent wants to run, the choices it offers (allow, allow from now on, deny) and a note the agent reads. The form cannot be sent until every question has an answer (a pick, or text in its own box) and a permission request has a choice picked. Give it `history` (AskAgent's last one) and the person sees the conversation beside the question. The run waits for the person without holding a worker, for as long as they take, while the agent still waits for the answer. If the agent stops waiting on its own (some agents drop a question after a while and carry on without it), the form is withdrawn and `answer` says the question was dropped (`dropped: true`): the next AskAgent firing hands that on, and comes back with what the agent did after it gave up. A question the agent marks secret is refused, because a form's answer is kept in the run in plain text: put the value in a file in the agent's folder and tell the agent where it is.

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: The conversation so far (a ChatHistory file, AskAgent's `history`), shown beside the question.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The person's answer, or word that the agent dropped the question (`dropped: true`): wire it into AskAgent's `answer`.
